title: Huaneng Zhengning Mine Water Treatment & Zero-Liquid Discharge Project
summary: Equipment manufacturing participation in an industrial mine-water deep treatment and zero-liquid discharge project, subject to verification of disclosed project and equipment supply records.
equipmentScope: Storage tanks and heat exchangers — confirm actual models, quantities, contract scope and public disclosure permission before publishing.
body:
Project Overview

The Huaneng Zhengning 2 × 1,000 MW coal power development includes mine-water deep treatment and zero-liquid discharge facilities.

Equipment Package Under Review

The preliminary internal reference list mentions storage tanks and heat exchangers in connection with the project. Before publication, confirm Tongyang's contractual role, equipment list, approved photographs and whether the project owner or EPC partner may be named.

Scope Clarification

Tongyang's equipment manufacturing participation must be distinguished from overall EPC design and construction responsibilities.
